# ghost/morse-translator

Morse (F-Droid): translate text to Morse code and Morse back to text in real time. Offline, no account. The camera permission dialog of the app is denied.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/morse-translator
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/morse-translator open_translator --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/morse-translator translate --device <serial> --param text=<text>
ghost skill run ghost/morse-translator get_translation --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/morse-translator clear_input --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_translator`: Open the Morse code translator
- `translate`: Translate Hello World to Morse code
- `get_translation`: What does the Morse translator show?
- `clear_input`: Clear the Morse translator
